message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a large yellow mobile crane on a white background. The crane's arm extends diagonally upward, with its hook lifting a large, 3D block shaped like the letter "B." On the ground below are three additional large 3D blocks shaped like the letters "U," "M," and "N." The "B," "M," and "N" are dark blue with grey sides, while the "U" is teal with grey sides. A man with black hair and a grey shirt sits inside the crane's cab, looking forward with a neutral expression. Grey smoke puffs emerge from the crane's rear.

Red text at the top reads "TEMPO," with smaller black text "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below. Other legible text includes "Dalang Pemalsuan Sertifikat Pagar Laut H.68," "Tata Tertib DPR yang Kebablasan H.32," and a headline "OBOK-OBOK BUMN." A descriptive paragraph mentions "Presiden Prabowo," "Danantara," "BPK," and "KPK. H.84." Technical details such as a barcode, "17-23 FEBRUARI 2025," "RP 60.000," and "ISSN: 0126-4273" are in the top right.
